accepted_pm_pattern.reuse: system MaterielPM OPHOURS row, PMLocation and one-hour task shape; G09 threshold/topology are new

source.rule: System OPHOURS PM counter should reflect selected system relative usage during mission; BASIC system USERT differs, PAR system USERT stays one. Counter may reach threshold during flight but task begins after return; winning counter and accumulated hours are not directly printed.

configuration.shared: Accepted G09.var04 use1 mixed BASIC series h8/h32 and PAR active parallel h20, one aircraft, direct CM, seed1/replication1/horizon36. Both arms suppress POS-B ordinary OPHOURS FRQ600000 to positive1e-9 (A already1e-9) to isolate PM. Add system MaterielPM SYS-OP15 OPHOURS1.5, PMLocation at BASE-01 and one-hour inspection task. Set Control.ENPM=Y in both arms; the accepted G09 parent has ENPM=N.
configuration.pair: Only description and BASIC TEACH-AIR-01/G09-SER-OPS MaterielOperationalModes.USERT differ: 0.5 versus1. PAR system USERT1 and all PM/physical/mission rows fixed.

pre_run_hypotheses: Both arms enable PM, convert with zero errors and reviewed diagnostics, exact populated-table roundtrip, and nonempty native SXO/log/report.

System OPHOURS1.5 PM should be due after first BASIC mission in full-use arm (two effective hours) but not in half-use arm (one effective hour); the half arm should first become due during PAR and start service after h22 return. Exact native task times and any later PMs are empirical.
Both arms have no ordinary failure under common positive near-zero rates and all three missions succeed, subject to observed native scheduling.
System/Stock reports reconcile mission outcomes, PM task/occupancy, 72 aligned bins, no stock movement and terminal readiness.
native_acceptance: Two immutable guarded serial session-0 SSH runs with host mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen source fingerprints and raw SHA seals.
Exact populated-table roundtrip, zero converter errors, reviewed diagnostics, nonempty output and event/PM/report/ledger reconciliation.
Independent read-only replay of first-PM timing contrast; selected usage and PM cumulative counter are source/manual/outcome inferred, not claimed as native-printed.
diagnostic_gate: If PM remains absent, or full first system PM does not precede half first system PM, or conversion produces errors/unreviewed warnings, retain immutable runs as diagnostic and revise under a new version/run ID without changing this contract.
limits: One system OPHOURS1.5 PM, BASIC system USERT0.5 versus1, PAR system1, common near-zero A/B ordinary failure inputs, one seed/replication/h36. No item-level or NC-set PM, multiple counters, other thresholds, population or general timing law. Both arms explicitly set ENPM=Y.
Native log may not expose counter value/winner; inference combines frozen source, exact roundtrip, installed manual and event/report. No GUI visual or cross-engine claim.

excluded_diagnostic.reason: Inherited G09 Control.ENPM=N disabled all PM; both frozen native arms converted and roundtripped but logged no PM and had NPMS0, violating the first-PM gate.
